annotations.title: Find where something appeared in the dated log

description: Search the recent DATED LOG for a literal term or phrase when you need to know WHERE something was said. It matches the authored one-line essence as well as the body, so a fixed term written as the entry's state line is found. By default it scans every project this person belongs to; pass project to narrow it. Returns compact excerpts anchored by project, date and entry — never full days, and each excerpt says when it came from the essence. This searches what happened, not curated memory, and does NOT replace arroway_read before acting on a task.

project.description: Optional project slug. Omit it to search every project this person can access.

query.description: Literal term or phrase to find in recent dated-log entries. Matching is case-insensitive.

name: arroway_search_log
title: Find where something appeared in the dated log
